scientific_question: Can a direction-preserving dimensionless norm cap remove c_proj error-feedback overdrive without destroying the useful temporal direction retained by constant full carry?

evidence_before_registration.interpretation: A scalar late decay destroys useful 124M directional memory, while unconstrained carry overdrives at 350M. A norm cap preserves the residual direction and intervenes only on magnitude. Cap 192 is the smallest single preregistered intervention centered on the useful 124M terminal scale; no cap sweep is authorized.
